About Buntikki
Buntikki is a service-based product and engineering company that builds scalable digital products for startups and enterprises. We work on backend-heavy, production-grade systems across SaaS, fintech, healthcare, and AI-driven platforms.
We don’t build demos — we build real AI systems that go into live products used by real users.

Role Overview
We are looking for a Gen AI Engineer who will work on chatbots, autonomous AI agents, and AI-driven workflows for client and internal products.

This role is ideal for someone who understands how LLMs behave in production, can design agent logic, and is comfortable building the backend systems that power AI features.

This is a full-time, onsite role in Delhi.

What You’ll Be Doing

Build chatbots and AI agents for real-world use cases
Define and refine autonomous agents for chat data analysis and task inference
Design AI workflows for data ingestion, reasoning, and task generation
Implement evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, reliability, and consistency
Build reusable components for multi-agent systems
Design and manage prompt templates for summarization, classification, extraction, and reasoning
Maintain prompt libraries and automate prompt testing
Integrate LLMs into backend services using Node.js
Collaborate on deploying, monitoring, and improving AI agents in production
Explore new frameworks, models, and techniques to improve AI output quality
Contribute to product design, system architecture, and documentation
What You’ll Need

3–5 years of experience in backend, AI, or full-stack development
Strong backend development skills (Node.js is mandatory)
Hands-on experience building chatbots, AI agents, or AI workflows
Experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open models)
Experience with frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar
Exposure to RAG systems, embeddings, or vector databases
Solid understanding of prompt engineering, tool usage, and reasoning workflows
Experience with REST APIs and backend system design
Familiarity with databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, etc.)
Comfortable working in a service-based / client-facing environment
Python experience for AI experimentation or prototyping
Experience with Docker, AWS, CI/CD, or production monitoring
Prior work on multi-agent or tool-using AI systems
Willingness to work onsite in Delhi
Who You Are

A builder who thinks of GenAI as a system, not just a model
Comfortable shipping AI features into production
Strong backend mindset with attention to reliability and scale
Curious, hands-on, and eager to experiment
Clear communicator who works well with PMs, designers, and clients
What You’ll Get

Ownership of GenAI features across real client products
Opportunity to work deeply on AI agents, workflows, and evaluation
A focused, collaborative onsite team in Delhi
Exposure to diverse industries and problem statements
Strong learning curve in applied GenAI systems
